digest.component_or_area: CLI reference generation and distribution verification
propositions: CLI reference syntax and options must derive deterministically from ROUTES registry and committed help bytes, verified by --check mode in both gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py
Hand-maintained command census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, regex parsing) must be eliminated and replaced with runtime registry enumeration
Editorial content must be structurally separated from generated syntax sections and linted to prevent authority conflicts with parser artifacts
Clean wheel distribution must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes and no extraneous imports
All lazy handler/parser/selector references and capability-to-extra mappings must be resolvable without command execution
Same portable repo-local commands must execute identically in local and CI environments, including rebar-mcp as a separate entry point
